title: The Egg That Hums
text: In a nest of melted gold, cooled into ripples, sits one egg the size of a barrel. It is warm to the touch, and it hums a low note you feel in your teeth. The hum gets louder when your fiercest fighter is near, as if it already knows them.

options.label: Your fiercest, the one it hums for, cracks it open and drinks, answering its call.

outcomes.text: Scales first, by evening. Then the hunger, then the fire, and then nothing is ever quite the same.
It tastes of smoke and iron, and they come away stronger, with a heat in their blood that does not fade.
Something in it fights back on the way down, and it is not done fighting.

options.label: Wrap it up and carry it out carefully, before anything comes looking for it.

outcomes.text: It goes quiet in the dark of a pack, a warm weight against the spine. The scholars will pay well for it, and ask no questions.
Its mother wants it back. You hear her coming long before you see her, and then the sky is full of her.

options.label: Smash it before it hatches. The world has monsters enough.

outcomes.text: It goes out like a coal in the rain. The gold around it is still gold, and you take every piece.
Its mother heard. The sky goes dark with her, and she is not interested in apologies.
